page: Amazon Web Services m8i.32xlarge is a general-purpose instance powered by the Nitro hypervisor. It features an Intel Xeon 6975P-C processor with 128 vCPUs and 64 physical cores operating at a clock speed of 3.9 GHz. The system includes 512.0 GB of DDR5 memory running at 7 GHz, providing 4.0 GB of RAM per core. It does not include local storage or dedicated GPUs, but it delivers a baseline network bandwidth of 50 Gbps.

In benchmark testing, the m8i.32xlarge demonstrates top-tier multi-core CPU performance, ranking in the top 10% for stress-ng multi-core, Geekbench multi-core, and Passmark CPU tests. Single-core performance is moderate, placing in the middle 50% for stress-ng single-core and the top 25% for Geekbench single-core. The DDR5 memory subsystem achieves top-tier read bandwidth and strong write bandwidth. The processor's support for Advanced Vector Extensions and Advanced Matrix Extensions enables top-tier performance in LLM inference prompt processing and medium-model text generation.

This instance offers high resource density and memory bandwidth, making it a qualitatively cost-efficient option for large-scale, multi-threaded enterprise workloads without requiring specialized GPU hardware. It is highly suited for database operations, multi-threaded data decompression, static web serving, and CPU-based machine learning inference.
